description: Redacts secrets and optional PII from every provider-bound request with stable opaque placeholders and gates reads of sensitive paths

secrets.title: Secret checks
secrets.description: Which secret patterns to catch, such as private keys, cloud and API keys, tokens and passwords in URLs

pii.title: Personal data checks
pii.description: Personal data to catch: email, phone, ipv4, ipv6, card, us_ssn; none by default

scopes.title: Text to scan
scopes.description: Where to look: your prompts, instructions and context, tool calls and output, earlier replies

paths.title: Sensitive paths
paths.description: When a shell command names a sensitive file: ask first, deny it, or off

sensitive_paths.title: Sensitive path patterns
sensitive_paths.description: File patterns that count as sensitive, such as .env, keys and SSH or cloud credentials

exempt.title: Exemptions
exempt.description: Allowed exceptions: sha256:HEX, domain:NAME or path:PATTERN, such as .env.example

unscanned.title: Unscanned attachments
unscanned.description: Images, audio and files can't be scanned: allow sends them, deny refuses the request
